source_metadata.case_title: Shot 17133 current | four-face neutral desorption and vacuum flight
source_metadata.time_registration: Unshifted published Fig.C.19 current coordinate; start at first retained point0.749788055492ns with uniform-DC magnetic initialization and300K; agreement with ALEGRA snapshot clock is an explicit unverified comparison scenario
source_metadata.model_description: Native constant-property MFEM Joule heating, finite-inventory first-order desorption, flux-weighted 3V thermal launches and exact neutral vacuum flight
assumptions: Explicit illustrative independent surface reservoirs and common first-order rates; not calibrated water/SS304 desorption or reaction branching. Equal per-area coverage/rate laws on all four faces are a stated hypothesis; side inventory uses its actual smaller area.

collisionless neutral free flight; absorbing map boundaries and upper foil; invariant/periodic current direction; no reactions or applied force; remote return conductor is outside this near-foil observation box
H, H2, H2O and OH are four independent assumed initial adsorbate pools; no conversion between species or claim of H2O fragmentation
All four perimeter material faces emit with the same per-area kinetic and initial-coverage assumptions; side areas are not inflated.
Current direction is invariant/periodic: z velocity is retained for energy, while maps integrate over the declared current length.

MFEM 2D A_z current-constrained magnetoquasistatic extension with finite-width foil, return conductor and true nonconducting exterior; prescribed recovered shot17133 current, constant provisional properties, no phase/motion/Hall feedback; not the earlier uniform-voltage metal-only demo; side faces use actual material-boundary traces from the same native solution
Surface removal energy is a passive diagnostic and is not fed back into MFEM temperature.
Conditional source-event times use the existing exact frozen-temperature Temkin/first-order law; no frame-midpoint injection.
Histograms use gas-side ownership for points exactly on material faces; trajectories themselves are not shifted.
Packet representation omits only per-component tails below the explicitly recorded numerical particle cutoff; original law histories are preserved, and omitted count bounds are reported separately.
No water chemistry, fragment recoil, collisions, radiation, plasma forces or calibrated density/temperature inference is claimed.

source_attributes.unit_mapping_reference: SI MFEM A_z MQS current constraints and conductor-only heat FE; no numerical vacuum conductivity or thermal material
source_attributes.source_clock_reference: Preserve unshifted published C.19 time. Assume it is comparable to the published ALEGRA clock; this registration is unverified.
source_attributes.temperature_zero_convention_reference: At the first supported trace knot, initialize uniform DC conductor currents +/-I0, solve the static magnetic A_z field, and set temperature to300K. Prehistory and deposited heat before this timestamp are unknown, not reconstructed.

mfem_face.full_width_coverage_reference: Aligned native rectangular material-face quadrature checked against every dx; invariant current direction extruded once

mfem_solver_scope.qualification_reference: Provisional constant-property current-constrained foil/return/vacuum MQS, not stock Joule or qualified ALEGRA reproduction
